sql_equivalency_summary.note: SQL Equivalency tool returned ERROR for all statement pairs. Results are documented as-is from the tool without agent judgment.

changes: SqlConnection -> NpgsqlConnection (3 occurrences: field, method return type, constructor)
SqlCommand -> NpgsqlCommand (7 occurrences: one per SQL method)
Replaced 7 SQL Server SQL statements with PostgreSQL equivalents
GETDATE() -> clock_timestamp() in all transaction statements
DECLARE @var/SET @var -> Writable CTE with old_values pattern
BEGIN TRANSACTION/COMMIT -> Writable CTE (single statement pattern)
Table/column names converted to lowercase per DMS schema mapping
Added column aliases (AS "ProductId", etc.) for MapProductFromReader compatibility
Removed SQL Server-specific parameters: Trusted_Connection, MultipleActiveResultSets, TrustServerCertificate

manual_interventions.reason: DMS statement_conversion_tool failed for all 7 statements with 'Metadata model creation did not complete after 15 attempts'
manual_interventions.action: Used DMS schema_mapping_tool successfully to obtain target schema/table/column name mappings, then manually converted all statements applying lowercase naming convention per DMS schema mappings
manual_interventions.impact: All conversions follow DMS-provided schema mapping patterns

manual_interventions.reason: SQL Server DECLARE/@var/BEGIN TRANSACTION/COMMIT patterns not compatible with PostgreSQL + Npgsql parameterized queries
manual_interventions.action: Restructured to use PostgreSQL writable CTEs with INSERT...RETURNING, UPDATE...RETURNING, and old_values CTE patterns
manual_interventions.impact: Same functional behavior achieved through different SQL structure

manual_interventions.reason: PostgreSQL returns lowercase column names by default, but MapProductFromReader expects PascalCase column names
manual_interventions.action: Added explicit column aliases (AS "ProductId", AS "Name", etc.) in SELECT statements that feed MapProductFromReader
manual_interventions.impact: Preserves compatibility with existing C# data reader code
